questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = 2(x - 3)^2 + 4.
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we expand and simplify. The general form is y = ax^2 + bx + c.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Not expanding the squared term correctly. Some students may forget to multiply the coefficient of x by 2 when expanding (x - 3)^2.

questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = -(x + 5)(x - 1).
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we multiply the binomials and simplify.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Incorrectly distributing the negative sign. Some students may distribute the negative sign to only one term instead of both terms in each binomial.

questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = (x - 2)(x + 3) - 4.
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we multiply the binomials and simplify.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Forgetting to multiply the constant term in the second binomial. Some students may forget to multiply -4 by (x - 2).

questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = 3(x + 1)^2 - 2(x + 1) - 1.
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we expand and simplify.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Not distributing the coefficient of x correctly in the expanded term. Some students may distribute 3 to only one term instead of two terms.

questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = -2(x - 4)(x + 2) + 1.
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we multiply the binomials and simplify.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Forgetting to distribute the negative sign in front of the binomial product. Some students may not multiply -2 by (x - 4)(x + 2).

questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = 4(x - 1/2)^2 - 3.
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we expand and simplify.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Incorrectly squaring the binomial. Some students may square only one term instead of both terms in (x - 1/2).

questions.stem: Convert the quadratic equation to general form: y = -(x + 3/2)(x - 5/4).
questions.solution: To convert the given equation to general form, we multiply the binomials and simplify.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Incorrectly multiplying the fractions. Some students may not correctly multiply the numerators and denominators when multiplying the binomials.
